resolution: Implemented the user's ruling that build-piece faces keep the existing front/back/sides slot model ('each already owns its own slot so it shouldnt be a change ... front back sides is fine'). The redesigned PAINT face row is now the piece's REAL skin slots (front/back/sides; a plate reads top/bottom/edges) instead of the old N/E/S/W/Top/In compass mapping — no engine change. Each face renders its ACTUAL current look (the material's own preview, or its colour), not a status dot. Clicking a face TARGETS that slot (a skin then paints only it); with no target a skin paints every slot, matching 'click a face to change it, otherwise edit every face'. Removed the now-dead faceSlotOf/FaceId/FACE_BUTTONS compass code. Verified by a clean full-graph esbuild pass.
